title: Find a device from the keyboard
description: Open the command palette with Ctrl-K, type part of a name, read which location each match sits under, narrow it to one device and press Enter to open it.

steps.caption: The console's home. The command palette is a keystroke away from every page.
The top bar's Search button is the same door, with its shortcut beside it.
Ctrl-K (Cmd-K on a Mac) opens the command palette with the cursor already in its field.
Before you type, it lists the pages you may open.
Type part of a name. Many components share the name videobar-1, one in every room.
Matches come in groups. Each component shows the locations it sits under, so one name is told apart from the next.
Keep typing to narrow it. Only one component is called videobar-2.
The first match is the default, and Ask omnibot is only ever the last row.
Enter opens the highlighted match, here the component's own page.
The component's page, reached without touching the mouse.
